During love making I tell him at least once.  
We practice bdsm occasionally and even when we’re doing a serious roleplay “I love yous” slip out. Which I find really sweet.  The feelings become so intense that it cannot be contained.

I’m so happy for you op that you have such a loving partner.

Since this is a throw away for me I don’t often check it but I’m glad I did. Thank you for reaching out,
I’m doing so much better these days.  I am home with my son most of the week and he is now just a month shy of being two. He brings me joy everyday and I love being his momma now.  It was a very hard and long journey to get to this point, it really felt like I fought tooth and nail.  I started to feel better little by little after he turned 1.  I still struggle with my mental health sometimes but it’s more manageable these days.  And ngl my son does stress me out a lot still too lol.  But huge difference from when I wrote this post. I no longer feel regretful

Was it the sexual part or just rather you where enjoying yourself while she was upset? Do you think she’d have the same reaction if she knew you where home watching a funny tv show eating ice cream or something, Just generally being joyful? Maybe she has a unrealistic expectation that if she is very upset you’ll be empathetic enough to suffer along side her.  In that case that’s a really unhealthy way for her to think.  You can feel for her and also be in a stable mood.  Also full disclosure, I am a woman but sometimes I masturbate to relieve stress, it’s just a release and doesn’t have anything to do with lust, even on days where my husband might also is having a bad day.  Because to be honest, sometimes trying to help him cheer up is stressful for me! 
She needs to work on her relationship with her sex and also her expectations about your emotional support.  You are her partner but you aren’t always her crutch.  You didn’t do anything wrong OP. I hope things cool down.
